lighting_isotropy.metric: 36-bin land-luminance-gradient peak divided by uniform-bin mean; gradients below 12 luminance units excluded
lighting_isotropy.visual_check: Neutral form shading and ambient occlusion only; no cast-shadow field or directional daylight key observed.

median_conifer_crown_final_scale.measurement: Median visual crown-width sample across mature conifers, converted by 2560/1254 to final canvas scale.

buildable_vs_steep_fraction.basis: estimated fraction of non-water land area
buildable_vs_steep_fraction.method: Authoring-zone estimate from coherent plateau and bench surfaces versus exposed cliff faces, gorge walls, talus, and dense vegetation.

water_mask.encoding: opaque white water pixels on fully transparent non-water pixels
water_mask.method: Source-registered geometry-aware classification guide followed by deterministic connected-component cleanup and enclosed-hole filling; the terrain source was not changed.

open_risks: Visual quality and seam acceptance remain owner decisions; mechanical checks do not establish acceptance.

image_generation.candidate_2_rejected_reason: Introduced sea across the south edge, violating the east-edge-only coast topology.
image_generation.water_mask_revision_role: Segmentation guide only; the selected terrain source remained byte-identical.
